name: K8bas Skyblock Utility
description: A modular client-side toolkit for Hypixel SkyBlock: rule-based outlines for the mobs and NPCs you can see, island-aware waypoints with beacon beams for NPCs at fixed spots, a searchable settings screen with mob and NPC lists, and a notify-only update check on GitHub. Display only: no automation, and no packet is cancelled or changed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel.
